import urllib.request
import json
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Descriptors

# Let's inspect CID 27692
url = "https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/27692/JSON"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

props = data['PC_Compounds'][0]['props']
for p in props:
    if p.get('urn', {}).get('label') == 'Molecular Weight':
        print("MW prop for CID 27692:", p)

# Let's check RDKit calculation
smiles_drom = "CC1CC2(C(CCC3C2CCC4(C3CCC4O)C)CC1=O)C"
smiles_andro = "CCC(=O)OC1CCC2C1(CCC3C2CCC4C3(C=CC(=O)C4)C)C"

mol_drom = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles_drom)
mol_andro = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles_andro)

print("RDKit MW Dromostanolone:", Descriptors.MolWt(mol_drom))
print("RDKit MW Androstenonol propionate:", Descriptors.MolWt(mol_andro))
